question: Should this protected-label PR be manually closed as superseded by merged PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101181 and current main, or kept open for a specific unique reason?
rationale: Repository policy blocks automated cleanup closure for protected `maintainer` labels even when the code evidence shows the useful behavior is already on main.

options.title: Close as superseded by current main
options.body: Use the merged successor PR and current-main source/tests as the canonical implementation, leaving this branch out of the merge queue.

options.title: Keep open for a named unique remainder
options.body: Only keep this PR open if a maintainer identifies behavior from this branch that is not already covered by PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101181 or adjacent API work.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded by current main
recommendation.body: Use the merged successor PR and current-main source/tests as the canonical implementation, leaving this branch out of the merge queue.
